actual_checks: Full exact prompt, API/meta, report, source notes, author/contribution records, full prior announcement, original checker, complete certificate data and author verification record read/inspected. Gaussian-prime classification handles nonaxis norm primes, axis absolute primes 3 mod 4, excludes zero/units, and includes ramified +/-1+/-i. All associates are actual distinct vertices. Allowed integer offsets exactly enumerate 0<u^2+v^2<=8; origin is a root, not a prime.

Checker independently sieves through 2*(84+floor(sqrt8))^2, covering every certificate vertex and candidate neighbor norm; axis tests are covered too. Explicit require checks survive normal execution and include unique integer coordinates, prime membership, exact child/parent sets, nonzero bounded edges, tree reachability and every possible prime exit. A path first leaving the verified finite set would contradict closure; no outside-disk assumption enters the proof.

Read checker before execution. Actually ran verification-only and explicit -O refusal in an isolated byte-identical copy, retaining both streams and hashes under qualified_execution. Normal exit 0 reproduces 2996 Gaussian primes, max norm 8737, max coordinate 84, 18853 neighbor positions and exact certificate SHA a7a91f2277ee6df59deb4b229e2b546e34e8a4fa070951c5ff7c1407ac8a3755. Optimized exit 1 states refusal. Original bytes unchanged; no BFS regeneration or author negative-control rerun claimed.

The octant count 380 cannot be multiplied by eight without orbit-boundary corrections. Full-plane data avoid that error; farthest 84+41i agrees with source. Smaller bounds are contained in this component, while arbitrary starting components and larger finite bounds remain outside the certified scope.
